data.name: Taita-Taveta
data.description: Known for Tsavo National Parks, wildlife conservation, and scenic Taita Hills.

data.name: Kitui
data.description: Semi-arid county known for livestock keeping, mining, and traditional crafts.

data.name: Mombasa
data.description: Coastal city and major port. Famous for beautiful beaches, historical sites like Fort Jesus, and Swahili culture. Tourism hotspot.

data.name: Laikipia
data.description: Wildlife conservation county. Known for private ranches and community conservancies.

data.name: Nairobi
data.description: Capital city and economic hub of Kenya. Known as the 'Green City in the Sun' with vibrant nightlife, business centers, and diverse entertainment options.

data.name: Tharaka-Nithi
data.description: Agricultural county known for miraa, coffee, and fruit farming along the Tana River.

data.name: Kirinyaga
data.description: County on the slopes of Mount Kenya. Known for rice farming in Mwea and coffee production.

data.name: Vihiga
data.description: Smallest county in Kenya. Known for sugarcane farming and Luhya cultural heritage.

data.name: Homa Bay
data.description: County on Lake Victoria shores. Known for fishing industry and Ruma National Park.

data.name: Elgeyo-Marakwet
data.description: County with Kerio Valley. Known for athletics champions and scenic landscapes.

data.name: Migori
data.description: County with Macalder gold mines. Known for sugarcane farming and Lake Victoria fishing.

data.name: Siaya
data.description: Home to Lake Victoria beaches. Known as the home of the first African US President's father.

data.name: Kisumu
data.description: Third largest city in Kenya. Located on the shores of Lake Victoria. Known for fishing industry and vibrant lakeside culture.

data.name: Nyeri
data.description: Home to Mount Kenya and Aberdare Ranges. Rich agricultural land and historical significance.

data.name: Wajir
data.description: Largest county in Northeastern Kenya. Known for livestock keeping and pastoralist communities.

data.name: Machakos
data.description: Part of Nairobi Metropolitan. Known for sandstone hills, vibrant markets, and growing urban centers.

data.name: Uasin Gishu
data.description: Home to Eldoret town, known as the 'City of Champions' for producing world-class athletes. Major agricultural region.

data.name: Meru
data.description: Agricultural county known for miraa (khat), coffee, and tea. Rich cultural heritage of the Meru people.

data.name: Tana River
data.description: County along the Tana River, known for irrigation agriculture and wildlife reserves.

data.name: Kisii
data.description: Densely populated county known for soapstone carvings, banana farming, and the Gusii people's rich culture.

data.name: Baringo
data.description: County with Lake Baringo and Lake Bogoria. Known for geothermal activity and wildlife.

data.name: Kajiado
data.description: Maasai county bordering Tanzania. Known for wildlife, Maasai culture, and growing urban centers.

data.name: Embu
data.description: Agricultural county on the slopes of Mount Kenya. Known for coffee, tea, and macadamia nuts.

data.name: Turkana
data.description: Largest county in Kenya. Known for Lake Turkana, oil discoveries, and Turkana people's rich culture.

data.name: Marsabit
data.description: County with Marsabit National Park and Lake Turkana. Known for diverse ethnic communities.

data.name: Kericho
data.description: Tea-growing capital of Kenya. Famous for vast tea plantations and cool climate.

data.name: Kilifi
data.description: Coastal county with popular tourist destinations like Malindi and Watamu. Known for beautiful beaches and marine parks.

data.name: Nandi
data.description: Home of champions. Known for producing world-class athletes and tea farming.

data.name: Busia
data.description: Border county with Uganda. Known for cross-border trade and fishing on Lake Victoria.

data.name: Narok
data.description: Home to Maasai Mara National Reserve, famous for the Great Wildebeest Migration.

data.name: Bomet
data.description: Agricultural county known for tea farming and dairy production in the South Rift region.

data.name: Nyamira
data.description: Agricultural county known for tea, bananas, and pyrethrum farming in Gusii highlands.

data.name: Garissa
data.description: Northeastern county and commercial hub. Known for Somali culture and Tana River delta.

data.name: Makueni
data.description: Eastern Kenya county known for fruit farming (mangoes, oranges) and vibrant markets.

data.name: Murang'a
data.description: Central Kenya county known as the 'heartland of the Kikuyu'. Famous for coffee and fresh produce.

data.name: Kiambu
data.description: Part of Nairobi Metropolitan Region. Known for coffee farming, affluent suburbs, and proximity to the capital.

data.name: Kwale
data.description: Coastal county with Diani Beach and Shimba Hills National Reserve. Known for pristine beaches and coral reefs.

data.name: Samburu
data.description: Home to Samburu National Reserve. Known for the colorful Samburu culture and wildlife.

data.name: West Pokot
data.description: County with Cherangani Hills. Known for pastoralism and vibrant cultural festivals.

data.name: Mandera
data.description: Border county with Ethiopia and Somalia. Known for livestock trade and pastoralist lifestyle.

data.name: Nakuru
data.description: Home to Lake Nakuru National Park (flamingos) and Menengai Crater. Major agricultural and tourism county.

data.name: Kakamega
data.description: Home to Kakamega Forest, the only tropical rainforest in Kenya. Known for sugarcane farming and Luhya culture.

data.name: Nyandarua
data.description: Agricultural county in the Aberdare Ranges. Known for potato farming and dairy production.

data.name: Bungoma
data.description: Agricultural county known for sugarcane farming. Home to the famous bullfighting tradition.

data.name: Trans Nzoia
data.description: Breadbasket of Kenya. Known for large-scale wheat and maize farming.

data.name: Lamu
data.description: Archipelago county with UNESCO World Heritage site Lamu Old Town. Known for Swahili architecture and culture.

data.name: Isiolo
data.description: Gateway to Northern Kenya. Known for wildlife conservation and diverse cultures.
